messages:
alex: alert from observability — control-plane KV store in eu-west1 showing raft split, config propagation stalled, console writes failing :warning:
alex: dashboard: https://grafana.internal.redwood/c/ctlplane-kv?panel=3
alex: logs: `error: raft: heartbeat timeout, candidate starting election` repeated across half the kv nodes
priya: seeing authz fetch failures from edge routers in eu-west1, 502s spiking to 15% :grimacing:
jamie: GPU fleet controllers still reporting healthy, but provisioning jobs stuck waiting on config apply for new nodegroups in eu-west1
sasha: going to run read-only checks — can console still serve reads? any manual rollouts in progress?
infra-bot: Notice: Automated canary rollout paused due to config propagation timeout (runbook ref: infra/runbooks/config-propagation.md) :gear:
alex: confirmed console is read-only for dashboards that require latest routing map, basic metrics read OK
priya: suggestion — shift control-plane traffic for eu-west1 to standby control-plane in eu-west2, keep data-plane (GPU) local to avoid bulk egress; need quick routing change in edge LB
jamie: agreed, but we need to ensure feature flags for region pinning are respected. If we redirect control plane, some control-plane-only calls may hit rate limits in eu-west2.
alex: rolling plan: (1) pause new provisioning in eu-west1 (2) shift control-plane control traffic to eu-west2 via lb-update (3) trigger kv membership reconcile in eu-west1 with `kvctl force-reconcile --region eu-west1`
priya: I'll update LB with a weight change now. Command: `kubectl patch svc ctlplane-lb -n infra -p '{"spec":{"weights":{"eu-west1":10,"eu-west2":90}}}'`
sasha: I can run `kvctl` once traffic is shifted. If raft leader election still flaps, might need a rolling restart of kv nodes (one at a time) — follow the rolling restart playbook.
mike: FYI cost note — if we run everything across eu-west2 for an extended period, cross-region egress will rise. Ops: monitor billing alert `infra.cross_region_egress` and set temp threshold higher by 20% if needed.
infra-bot: Action: LB weights updated by priya at 1812345801
jamie: LB change observed, control-plane traffic to eu-west2 up to 85% according to tracing: https://jaeger.internal.redwood/trace/ctlplane-shift
priya: starting kv reconcile in eu-west1 now — `kvctl force-reconcile --region eu-west1 --timeout 60s`
priya: reconcile output: "stalled nodes: kv-3,kv-5; joining leader kv-1"
alex: starting rolling restart of kv-3 (one node) — taking gracefully out of rotation
sasha: kv-3 restarted, logs show previous disk read errors, mounting read-only before restart. Disk apparently remounted fine.
jamie: after restart kv cluster shows stable quorum, leader elected kv-1, config propagation resumed, canaries are progressing
ella: console write path restored, manual writes tested (config rollout succeeded for a small canary) :white_check_mark:
alex: provisioning jobs in eu-west1 picked up again, GPU nodegroups completed bootstrap for two pending jobs
mike: cross-region egress spiked 32% during shift; billing alert fired. I've set a temporary waiver for the alert and flagged finance.
priya: monitoring — auth 502s down to baseline, router dropped error rate from 15% -> 1.5% in 12 minutes
alex: summary: root cause appears to be transient disk/read errors on kv nodes leading to raft instability, exacerbated by load during a config rollout. Mitigation: shifted control-plane traffic, reconciled cluster, rolling restarted affected kv nodes, resumed provisioning.
jamie: next steps: run disk health checks on kv nodes in eu-west1, add an automated pre-rollout health gate for kv quorum, and schedule replacement for degraded disks.
sasha: logging an incident postmortem and linking playbook steps and commands used. I'll include commands and timestamps.
alex: thanks all — keep eyes on console for any resurgence, and @oncall if error rate > 5%
infra-bot: Incident status: mitigated at 1812345918, monitoring for 30m stable window
priya: :thumbsup:
